subject: US-200: Team Billing Schema Design
description:
# US-200: Team Billing Schema Design

## Objective
Design and implement database schema for team billing infrastructure.

## Technical Tasks

### 1. Create Core Billing Tables
- `team_billing` table with Stripe customer ID
- `team_subscriptions` table with plan management
- `team_usage_metrics` table for tracking

### 2. Database Migrations
- Create Alembic migration script
- Add foreign key constraints
- Create indexes for performance

### 3. SQLAlchemy Models
- TeamBilling model with relationships
- TeamSubscription model with status enum
- TeamUsageMetrics model with aggregations

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 3 tables created successfully
- [ ] Foreign key constraints validated
- [ ] Indexes created (team_id, stripe_customer_id)
- [ ] Migration runs without errors
- [ ] Rollback migration works correctly
- [ ] Unit tests for models (90%+ coverage)

## Dependencies
- SPEC-006 (User Management - teams table exists)
- PostgreSQL 14+
- Alembic migration system

## Estimated Effort
8-10 hours (1-1.5 days)

## Related
- Blocks: US-203, US-204
- SPEC: SPEC-026 Phase 1

subject: US-209: Stripe Invoice & Webhook Integration
description:
# US-209: Stripe Invoice & Webhook Integration

## Objective
Integrate Stripe invoice generation and webhook event handling for real-time billing updates.

## Implementation Tasks

### 1. Invoice Generation
- Auto-generate invoices on billing cycle
- Apply credits to invoices automatically
- Send invoices via email
- Store invoice IDs in database

### 2. Webhook Event Handlers
Implement handlers for 8 webhook events:
- customer.subscription.created
- customer.subscription.updated
- customer.subscription.deleted
- invoice.payment_succeeded
- invoice.payment_failed
- charge.succeeded
- charge.failed
- payment_intent.succeeded

### 3. Webhook Security
- Verify Stripe signature on all webhooks
- Idempotent event processing (store event IDs)
- Handle duplicate webhook deliveries

### 4. Failed Payment Handling (Dunning)
- Retry failed payments (3 attempts)
- Send email notifications on failures
- Update subscription status to past_due
- Suspend team access after 7 days past_due

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Invoices generated correctly on billing cycle
- [ ] Credits applied automatically to invoices
- [ ] All 8 webhook events handled correctly
- [ ] Webhook signature verification implemented
- [ ] Idempotent event processing
- [ ] Failed payment retries work (3 attempts)
- [ ] Email notifications sent on payment failure
- [ ] Subscription status updated from webhooks
- [ ] Integration tests for all webhook scenarios
- [ ] Webhook endpoint documented

## Dependencies
- US-207, US-208 (Stripe customer & subscriptions)
- SPEC-027 (webhook foundation)

## Estimated Effort
16-20 hours (2-3 days)

## Related
- Completes: Phase 3
- SPEC: SPEC-026 Phase 3

description:
# US-214: Billing Security Audit

## Objective
Conduct comprehensive security audit for billing infrastructure and ensure PCI compliance.

## Audit Areas

### 1. PCI Compliance Verification
- No credit card data stored in database
- Stripe handles all sensitive data
- Secure token storage (encrypted)
- TLS 1.3 for all API communication

### 2. Access Control
- RBAC enforcement for billing operations
- vendor_admin role verification
- Team admin role verification
- JWT token validation

### 3. Data Encryption
- Billing data encrypted at rest (AES-256)
- API keys in environment variables
- Stripe webhook signature verification
- Secure session management

### 4. Rate Limiting
- Discount code application (10/hour)
- Payment method updates (5/hour)
- API endpoint rate limits
- DDoS protection

### 5. Audit Logging
- All billing operations logged
- Admin actions tracked
- Failed login attempts logged
- Suspicious activity alerts

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] PCI DSS compliance verified (Level 1)
- [ ] No card data in database confirmed
- [ ] All API keys in env variables
- [ ] Encryption at rest validated
- [ ] RBAC tested for all endpoints
- [ ] Rate limiting functional
- [ ] Audit logs capture all operations
- [ ] Security scan shows no HIGH/CRITICAL issues
- [ ] Penetration test report clean
- [ ] Compliance documentation updated

## Tools

- OWASP ZAP (penetration testing)
- npm audit (frontend)
- Manual code review

## Estimated Effort
